problem: The boot watchdog still attempted to recover an external RDC capability that had been formally retired fail-closed, causing false unhealthy state while the runner was available.

solution.primary: Windows AtStartup S4U watchdog for the GitHub Actions runner with the external RDC explicitly retired fail-closed
solution.uac_activation: Last-resort governed launcher after a fixed local passwordless schtasks /NP registration attempt; restricted to immutable release register-task-com metadata
solution.independent_runner_recovery: Attempt start_runner without probing, starting or recovering the retired RDC capability.
solution.partial_evidence: Persist separate runner_recovery_ok, rdc_recovery_ok, partial, github_pickup_required; rdc_recovery_ok means retirement-policy compliance, while errors expose types only and never exception text.

sdd_gate.evidence_contract: The watchdog must recover the local GitHub runner and persist the external RDC as retired_fail_closed with the canonical marker, without reading claims or invoking any RDC recovery path. If COM registration is unavailable or denied, one fixed local passwordless schtasks /NP registration is allowed for the exact task; independent XML must prove enabled+AtStartup+S4U. If native registration is also denied, activation remains fail-closed until the governed UAC launcher registers the immutable release task. Persist independent health flags and require external runner pickup E2E before declaring runtime ready.

quality_followup.finding: CodeQL empty-except findings eliminated with explicit fallback/evidence semantics.

runner_first_fix.reason: Physical readback: installed watchdog release is rdc_first, latest cycle failed, and no dedicated runner auto-service exists.
runner_first_fix.runtime_gate: Versioned, reversible on-host update and independent post-boot pickup; no reboot before attested readiness.
